//: Thresholds for scripts/check-change-size.sh (PR tier only — no local entry).
A PR over EITHER threshold must carry the acknowledgement token in its body.
WHAT THIS IS NOT: enforcement. `main` requires 0 approving reviews, so the author
adds the token themselves. It buys exactly one thing — size becomes a recorded
decision instead of an unremarked accident. Calling it a control would be the
fiction this repo keeps deleting. See .claude/rules/60-ai-governance.md §13.
MEASURED, not guessed: 149 merges into main (git log --merges --first-parent),
counting the same exclusions this gate applies, on 2026-08-09:
p50   10 files /    328 lines
p75   48 files /   2161 lines
p90  143 files /  10423 lines   <- thresholds sit here
p95  284 files /  23458 lines
max  899 files / 172120 lines
Set at p90 so roughly one PR in ten is asked to say its size was intended. An
earlier draft of this file carried invented numbers (80/3500) that read as
measured; at the real distribution that is about p80, firing on a quarter of all
work — which is how a gate becomes noise and then gets routed around. Re-measure
before changing these, and say so here.
Excluded paths are generated, vendored or maintainer-local: their size is not a
review burden, and counting them would make a lockfile refresh look like a rewrite.
